pins.says: No UD documentation page declares these as clitics. Forms are attested as PART in the treebank (7,041 PART tokens, 513 distinct, but only ~15 are real particles). The treebank is a giver of CANDIDATES. Mandarin particles are separate words (no gluing), so the clitic-slice proponent does not fire on them.
